title: Normalise component granularity and naming
requirements:
- Define CDSE, surveillance platform and HMIS as bounded capabilities at a similar level
- Use one term for PKI vs trust architecture, terminology service vs server, and HMIS 'service' vs 'system'
- Give each component a preferred name, synonyms and excluded meanings
- Separate governed knowledge from execution for the CDSE, or call it a logical capability
- Distinguish ArchiMate 'Product' from health products in the Product Registry
- Scope the shared surveillance capabilities and the HMIS component name
- Present individual versus population level as a typical emphasis, not a boundary
